industries.hotels.description: Service and cleaning robots for hotels: room delivery, lobby and corridor cleaning, front-desk support. We cut costs and staff turnover. Calculate your ROI.
industries.hotels.name: Hotels and hospitality
industries.hotels.lead: Hotels run on frontline staff who are ever harder to hire and keep. Housekeepers, waiters, floor runners: turnover hurts both service and the budget.
industries.hotels.lead2: Robots take over the routine: room delivery, cleaning common areas and part of the front-desk work, so people can focus on guests.

industries.hotels.problems.items.0.text: High season: not enough people. Low season: a full team is costly.
industries.hotels.problems.items.1.title: Night lobby cleaning
industries.hotels.problems.items.1.text: Cleaning must happen when guests are out, and a night crew means premiums and the same turnover.

industries.hotels.problems.items.2.text: Towels, water and room orders eat into staff time.
industries.hotels.problems.items.3.title: Consistent guest experience
industries.hotels.problems.items.3.text: Service quality shouldn’t depend on who’s on shift today.
